items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Displays a button, or a component that looks like one, with a set of visual variants and sizes. Also exports LinkButton (react-aria-components' Link, same variants) for link-as-button use cases.
items.author: @fmartinsandre/ui

meta.origin: shadcn/ui, style: aria-nova (base: react-aria-components). No asChild — use LinkButton for a link styled as a button, and isDisabled instead of disabled.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A container for grouping related content, with header, title, description, action, content, and footer slots. Supports a compact size="sm" variant.
items.author: @fmartinsandre/ui
